content.text: The write paths all pass through the service layer. I found that comment edits and attachment writes also need an issue-level archive check, so those checks will run before the new project check.

input.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/services/_issue-write-guard.ts')
p.write_text('''import { assertNotArchived } from \"@/lib/soft-delete\";
import * as projectRepo from \"@/server/repositories/project-repository\";
import type { Issue } from \"@/types/issue\";
import { requireFound } from \"./_support\";

/** Guard writes to an issue and its sub-resources after authorization. */
export async function assertIssueWritable(issue: Issue): Promise<void> {
  assertNotArchived(\"Issue\", issue.id, issue);
  const project = requireFound(
    await projectRepo.findProjectById(issue.orgId, issue.projectId),
    \"Project\",
    issue.projectId,
  );
  assertNotArchived(\"Project\", project.id, project);
}
''')
p=Path('src/server/services/issue-service.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import {\\n  actorEnvelope,','import { assertIssueWritable } from \"./_issue-write-guard\";\\nimport {\\n  actorEnvelope,')
s=s.replace('  assertNotArchived(\"Issue\", before.id, before);','  await assertIssueWritable(before);').replace('  assertNotArchived(\"Issue\", issue.id, issue);','  await assertIssueWritable(issue);')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/comment-service.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import {\\n  actorEnvelope,','import { assertIssueWritable } from \"./_issue-write-guard\";\\nimport {\\n  actorEnvelope,')
s=s.replace('  assertNotArchived(\"Issue\", issue.id, issue);','  await assertIssueWritable(issue);')
needle='  assertNotArchived(\"Comment\", comment.id, comment);\\n'
replacement=needle+'''  const issue = requireFound(
    await issueRepo.findIssueById(input.orgId, comment.issueId),
    \"Issue\",
    comment.issueId,
  );
  await assertIssueWritable(issue);
'''
s=s.replace(needle,replacement)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/attachment-service.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import { issueResource, requireFound } from \"./_support\";','import { issueResource, requireFound } from \"./_support\";\\nimport { assertIssueWritable } from \"./_issue-write-guard\";')
s=s.replace('  assertCan(actor, \"issue:update\", issueResource(issue));','  assertCan(actor, \"issue:update\", issueResource(issue));\\n  await assertIssueWritable(issue);')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('import { attachments, comments, getDb, issueLabels, issues } from \"@/server/db\";','import { attachments, comments, getDb, issueLabels, issues, projects } from \"@/server/db\";')
old='''  const rows = getDb()
    .select()
    .from(issues)
    .where(
      and(
        ...compact(
          orgPredicate(issues.orgId, orgId),
          livePredicate(issues.archivedAt, {}),
          isNotNull(issues.dueAt),'''
new='''  const rows = getDb()
    .select({ issue: issues })
    .from(issues)
    .innerJoin(
      projects,
      and(eq(projects.id, issues.projectId), eq(projects.orgId, issues.orgId)),
    )
    .where(
      and(
        ...compact(
          orgPredicate(issues.orgId, orgId),
          livePredicate(issues.archivedAt, {}),
          livePredicate(projects.archivedAt, {}),
          isNotNull(issues.dueAt),'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new).replace('  return rows.map((row) => toIssue(row));\\n}', '  return rows.map((row) => toIssue(row.issue));\\n}')
p.write_text(s)
PY"
